description: Nodes and connectors of one page, with ids, labels and geometry, plus `selection`: the ids the user has selected on that page in the live editor ("the box I selected"; empty in file mode or when nothing is selected). Use get_diagram for a diagram's DSL.

documentId.description: File-mode document id from openflow_open or openflow_create; omit to use the paired editor (or, in file mode, the document opened or created last).

pageId.description: Page to read (see list_pages); defaults to the page the editor shows, or the first page in file mode.

name: get_document
title: Read the page
